name: c5_non_english_access
description: A Spanish request for a copy of personal data that says not to delete the account. It mentions 'eliminar' but does not authorize deletion, so a present profile must not make it a deletion case.

request.request_text: Hola, quisiera recibir una copia de todos mis datos personales. No quiero eliminar mi cuenta, solo saber qué información guardan sobre mí.
